summary: Restored persistent Postfix delivery for branch.test on node1. End-to-end delivery, rejection controls, preserved handover files, unchanged OS/kernel, and sequential restart recovery were verified.
actions_performed: Installed the Ubuntu-compatible Postfix package on node1.
Created locked local mailbox accounts alice and bob.
Configured helpdesk to deliver to alice and bob, and accounts to bob only.
Restricted relaying and enabled unknown-local-recipient rejection.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: helpdesk@branch.test reaches both alice and bob
evidence.summary: Node2 submitted helpdesk messages successfully; both alice and bob contain the original and post-restart message IDs.
The accounts message was accepted; final counts show bob=1 and alice=0.
Post-restart SMTP test returned 550 User unknown in local recipient table.

evidence.requirement: Relaying for unrelated domains is rejected
evidence.summary: Post-restart SMTP test returned 554 Relay access denied for example.net.

evidence.requirement: Sample messages and routing handover are preserved
evidence.summary: Original handover contents remain present with aliases.txt SHA-256 f72a4898… and sample.eml SHA-256 4b0b2984….

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic.
Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 01c87a03… to e904edca…; Postfix, aliases, mailboxes, queue, and handover recovered.
Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from bdd5de93… to 95b536bf…; networking recovered and node2 successfully submitted mail to node1.
